## Session 1: Introduction & Setup

- **Welcome & Overview**
  - Introduce workshop objectives and participant goals.
  - Provide an overview of Quarto: its purpose, strengths, and reproducibility benefits.
  - Present a brief look at the [Quarto Guide](https://quarto.org/docs/guide/).
- **Installation & Environment Setup**
  - Walkthrough on installing Quarto (via the command line or through IDE integrations such as RStudio or VS Code).
  - Live demo: creating a “Hello, Quarto” document.

## What is Quarto? {{< iconify thinking-face >}}

[Quarto](https://quarto.org/) is an open-source scientific and technical publishing system built on Pandoc. It is a next-generation R Markdown and Jupyter Notebook interface that allows you to create dynamic documents, reports, presentations, and websites.
